statements.status_notes: Unhandled exceptions in a set_tlsext_servername_callback callback accept the connection, affecting pyOpenSSL 0.14.0 up to but not including 26.0.0, first fixed in 26.0.0, which is a major version bump. This image keeps pyOpenSSL at the version upstream GitLab CNG pins for the matching release tag, so the crypto stack matches the one GitLab validated; taking 26.0.0 would put this image a major version ahead of CNG, including the FIPS variants. The code is reachable: urllib3 and google-auth import pyOpenSSL for the TLS path that gsutil uses. Resolves when CNG moves to pyOpenSSL 26.0.0 or later.
